directions.description: For any filtered system of nilperfect rings {R_i} with colimit R, the canonical map colim ℝW(R_i) → ℝW(R) is an isomorphism of abelian groups. This conjecture addresses the fundamental motivation for sheared Witt vectors: resolving the failure of W(R)/p^n to commute with filtered colimits while preserving essential Dieudonné-theoretic properties.
domain_bridges: Formalization of Witt vectors in mathlib (W. Park, 2023)
Filtered colimits in commutative algebra libraries
Perfect rings and Frobenius morphisms in characteristic p
directions.lean_theorem_stub: theorem sheared_witt_filtered_colimit_isomorphism {ι : Type*} (f : ι → Type*) [∀ i, Ring (f i)] [∀ i j, Ring (f j)] [∀ i, Nilperfect (f i)] [∀ i j, Nilperfect (f j)] [∀ i, ShearedWittComplete (f i)] (colim_ring : CLexColimit f) : (colim (fun i => sheared_witt_vectors (f i))) ≃ₗ[ℤ] sheared_witt_vectors colim_ring
directions.proof_strategy: Establish the isomorphism by proving ℝW preserves filtered colimits through the pullback definition and limit representation. Key steps: (1) Show ℎw commutes appropriately with filtered colimits using nilpotent element control, (2) Prove lim_F commutes with filtered colimits in the category of p-complete rings, (3) Apply the five lemma to the resulting diagram of short exact sequences.
directions.title: Sheared Witt Vectors Commutation with Filtered Colimits
